event_summary: A tan rod beside a black circular device sweeps into the rightmost set of upright blocks, after which the three right-side blocks tip over while the four left-side blocks remain upright.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with seven narrow rectangular blocks standing upright on a wooden tabletop, arranged as a left group of four and a right group of three. A black circular device sits to the right with a tan rod attached near a small green part on top. The tan rod changes orientation and sweeps outward toward the row of blocks. Its tip reaches the rightmost black block in the right group. The rightmost black block tips leftward, the adjacent white block also tips, and the left black block of the right group ends up no longer upright. By the end, the three right-side blocks are lying or leaning on the tabletop, while the four blocks on the left remain standing.

reasons: The tabletop, upright blocks, circular device, and rod are visible before the rod reaches the blocks.
The blocks are separated into a left standing group and a right standing group.
